ideas.title: The Impact of the Trump Administration's Immigration Policies on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's immigration policies on local communities, including the economic, social, and humanitarian impacts.
ideas.angle: The story would focus on the human side of the issue, highlighting the experiences of individuals and families affected by the policies.
questions: What are the economic impacts of the Trump administration's immigration policies on local communities?
How are individuals and families affected by the policies?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it would provide a nuanced and detailed look at the effects of the Trump administration's immigration policies on local communities. By highlighting the human side of the issue, the story could help to raise awareness and spark conversation about the need for more compassionate and effective immigration policies.
